description: This file defines the NoteRepository class, which provides database access methods for notes, including finding notes by parent ID, deleting notes by ID, and inserting new notes into the database.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database operations related to notes, extending a generic MySQL repository.

methods.name: findByParentId
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with a specific parent type and ID, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note record into the database.
